Overview

Online shop made in Prestashop 1.7 for tools, machine parts and agricultural and industrial equipment. I heavily customized the theme through HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and products that cannot be ordered online get two buttons: one to call and one to request details by email. The contact form was built by editing TPL, HTML and CSS around Contact Form 7. Products were imported by CSV from the previous WordPress site, and the shop stays permanently connected to the eMAG marketplace through an API feed module.
